title: Owner-authorized Dune and runtime preflight for daily macro execution
objective: Validate, without exposing secrets or mutating external data, that the owner-authorized Dune CLI can be used for the next daily macro execution slice and that PostgreSQL/Hermes runtime prerequisites are present.
owner_authorization: Owner authorized use of the existing Dune credential and a writable PostgreSQL target for the daily macro workflow. Hermes delivery remains pending a concrete callable integration contract.
forbidden_actions: Do not read, print, persist, copy or place credential values in a command, report, repository file or run artifact.
Do not create, edit, execute or pay for a Dune query/dashboard during this preflight.
Do not run a database migration, write to a database, retain provider payloads, or send a Feishu/Hermes message.
Do not activate BSC or Robinhood CA adapters, collectors, webhooks, backfills, trading, signing or execution capability.
deliverables: A preflight report recording only boolean/sanitized Dune CLI authentication capability, supported query-management commands, PostgreSQL configuration presence, Hermes callable-contract presence, and the exact next gate.
